verdict.rationale: Greenhouse Notetaker is built in and needs no extension or third-party login. It automatically records and transcribes interviews, then maps AI-generated notes and summaries directly to scorecard questions. That covers the recording, transcription and scorecard-distillation core of the story. missing for 10: no evidence of how candidate consent to recording is handled, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the Notetaker's quality.
